verdict.rationale: Attio ships a standard Deal object that models pipeline stages, lists to aggregate business processes, customizable fields, and explicit kanban board visualization ("From kanbans to tables, visualize your data the way that works for you") plus stage-conversion reporting, all supporting a visual, customizable pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshot confirming drag-and-drop stage updates specifically, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party marketing copy.
